title: BENCHMARKING LLM COMPETENCE ON LOGICAL INFERENCE OVER PROBABILITY OPERATORS
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating large language models on logical inference over probability operators (e.g., epistemic modals like 'might', 'must', 'probably'). It tests for answer biases and demographic biases (such as name origin and gender) but does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral judgment, or ethical frameworks.
